assigned_workers: SELECT w.id,w.work_pool_id,w.status FROM worker w WHERE w.id IN (SELECT s.assigned_worker_id FROM stream_physical_subtask s JOIN stream_graph_revision g ON g.id=s.graph_revision_id WHERE g.flow_run_id=$1 AND g.id=$2) ORDER BY w.id
authority: SELECT id,flow_run_id,generation,flow_run_run_count,state FROM stream_execution_authority WHERE flow_run_id=$1 ORDER BY id
coordinator_launches: SELECT id,flow_run_id,worker_id,work_pool_id,generation,state,child_process_id,process_start_ticks FROM native_stream_launch_identity WHERE flow_run_id=$1 ORDER BY id
edge_partitions: SELECT id,graph_revision_id,flow_run_id,edge_id,partition_index,stream_id,subscriber_id,target_subtask_id FROM stream_graph_edge_partition WHERE graph_revision_id=$1 AND flow_run_id=$2 ORDER BY id
edges: SELECT id,graph_revision_id,edge_uid,subscriber_uid,producer_port_id,consumer_port_id,producer_parallelism,target_parallelism,exchange,routing_version FROM stream_graph_edge WHERE graph_revision_id=$1 ORDER BY id
flow_lease: SELECT f.id,f.deployment_id,f.state_id,s.type AS state_type,s.state_details->>'deployment_concurrency_lease_id' AS deployment_concurrency_lease_id,d.concurrency_limit_id,c.active_slots AS deployment_active_slots,c."limit" AS deployment_limit FROM flow_run f LEFT JOIN flow_run_state s ON s.id=f.state_id LEFT JOIN deployment d ON d.id=f.deployment_id LEFT JOIN concurrency_limit_v2 c ON c.id=d.concurrency_limit_id WHERE f.id=$1
grants: SELECT a.id,a.subtask_id,a.worker_id,a.physical_epoch,a.state,a.child_process_id,a.process_start_ticks,a.created FROM stream_subtask_grant a JOIN stream_physical_subtask s ON s.id=a.subtask_id JOIN stream_graph_revision g ON g.id=s.graph_revision_id WHERE g.flow_run_id=$1 AND g.id=$2 ORDER BY a.id
launches: SELECT id,graph_revision_id,subtask_id,task_run_id,worker_id,attempt_index,planned_physical_epoch,state,child_process_id,process_start_ticks,created FROM stream_dag_launch_attempt WHERE graph_revision_id=$1 ORDER BY id
lease_history: SELECT id,type,timestamp,state_details->>'deployment_concurrency_lease_id' AS lease_id FROM flow_run_state WHERE flow_run_id=$1 AND state_details->>'deployment_concurrency_lease_id' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp,id LIMIT 32
limits: SELECT c.id,c.name,c."limit",c.active_slots,c.active,c.slot_decay_per_second FROM concurrency_limit_v2 c WHERE c.id IN (SELECT a.concurrency_limit_id FROM stream_subtask_allocation a JOIN stream_physical_subtask s ON s.id=a.subtask_id JOIN stream_graph_revision g ON g.id=s.graph_revision_id WHERE g.flow_run_id=$1 AND g.id=$2 UNION SELECT d.concurrency_limit_id FROM deployment d JOIN flow_run f ON f.deployment_id=d.id WHERE f.id=$1) ORDER BY c.id
operators: SELECT id,graph_revision_id,profile,operator_uid,role,parallelism,created FROM stream_operator_run WHERE graph_revision_id=$1 ORDER BY id
partitions: SELECT id,flow_run_id,producer_task_run_id,state,last_sequence,tail_sequence,producer_position,released,created FROM stream_partition WHERE flow_run_id=$1 ORDER BY id
physical_slots: SELECT p.id,p.graph_revision_id,p.subtask_id,p.worker_id,p.admission_operation_id,p.released,p.release_operation_id,p.released_at,p.created FROM stream_physical_slot_allocation p JOIN stream_graph_revision g ON g.id=p.graph_revision_id WHERE g.flow_run_id=$1 AND g.id=$2 ORDER BY p.id
ports: SELECT id,graph_revision_id,operator_run_id,port_uid,direction,schema_id,schema_version,schema_digest FROM stream_graph_port WHERE graph_revision_id=$1 ORDER BY id
scope: SELECT g.id AS graph_id,g.flow_run_id,g.profile,g.assignment_epoch,g.state,g.admission_operation_id,g.activation_operation_id,g.startup_completed_at,g.terminal_operation_id,f.deployment_id,f.run_count AS flow_run_count,f.state_type AS flow_state FROM stream_graph_revision g JOIN flow_run f ON f.id=g.flow_run_id WHERE g.id=$1 AND f.id=$2
subtasks: SELECT s.id,s.graph_revision_id,s.operator_run_id,s.subtask_index,s.assignment_epoch,s.task_run_id,s.submission_id,s.input_stream_id,s.output_stream_id,s.current_grant_id,s.physical_epoch,s.assigned_worker_id,s.physical_slot_released,s.created FROM stream_physical_subtask s JOIN stream_graph_revision g ON g.id=s.graph_revision_id WHERE g.flow_run_id=$1 AND g.id=$2 ORDER BY s.id
tag_allocations: SELECT a.id,a.subtask_id,a.concurrency_limit_id,a.released,a.created FROM stream_subtask_allocation a JOIN stream_physical_subtask s ON s.id=a.subtask_id JOIN stream_graph_revision g ON g.id=s.graph_revision_id WHERE g.flow_run_id=$1 AND g.id=$2 ORDER BY a.id
tasks: SELECT id,flow_run_id,task_key,dynamic_key,run_count,state_type,created FROM task_run WHERE flow_run_id=$1 ORDER BY id
